item.description:
What's New in VoiceInk 2.21

  • 🦜 Added support for Parakeet Ultra
  • 🌐 Added support for OpenRouter transcription models
  • 🤖 Added GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Sol enhancement models
  • ⚙️ Support for custom AI enhancement model IDs
  • ⌨️ Added double-tap recording shortcuts
  • ↩️ Made Auto Send a global setting with automatic Return delivery
  • 📋 Added mode duplication and context menu actions
  • 🧠 Added local CLI support for Dictionary Auto Learn
  • 📝 Improved dictionary editing and replacement rules
  • 🛠️ Minor bug fixes and improvements
